item.skyabyss.abyss_diver_armor.desc: The anchor-iron plate and chain the last excavation party wore down. 2 pieces: +3 toughness. 4 pieces: abyss climbing weight -40% and darkness build-up -20%; anywhere, -15% damage taken in the dark (light 4 or less)
item.skyabyss.abyss_lamp_sword.desc: The lamp-keeper's sword, a lantern hung from its guard. Cuts deeper in the light (light 8+, +10%). Foes struck in the dark glow for 4 s (+5: 6 s, and those nearby)
item.skyabyss.abyss_pulse_listener.desc: Worn as a trinket, every 4 s it hears the heartbeats of foes within 12 blocks and outlines them, even through walls. In the abyss, darkness builds 15% slower
item.skyabyss.abyss_lantern_charm.desc: Use from the charm slot to set a light at your feet (radius 8, 60 s; the same as a Light art lamp). Nearby foes glow and are pushed back; you gain night vision for 30 s. Cooldown 45 s
item.skyabyss.abyss_sinking_anchor.desc: A two-handed weapon made from a broken anchor fluke. Every 3rd hit (every 2nd from +5) a weight falls on nearby foes, hurting and slowing them and dragging them down
item.skyabyss.abyss_pulse_dagger.desc: Keep stabbing the same foe and the beats are counted: every 4th hit (every 3rd from +5) lands an extra beat and heals you a little
item.skyabyss.abyss_surveyor_plumb.desc: Worn as a trinket, you deal more damage the deeper you are (abyss: +1% per 40 depth, up to +12%; surface: +1% per 16 blocks below y 64, up to +8%). -30% fall damage
item.skyabyss.abyss_anchor_iron.desc: Heavy, cold iron brought up from the abyss floor. Enhances and repairs abyss gear
item.skyabyss.abyss_core.desc: A core still beating, left in the warden's chest. A material for artifacts
item.skyabyss.resonance_shard_abyss.desc: The abyss's Resonance Fragment. 30 trade for an abyss exclusive. Dropped by the heart's warden and the layer lords, and returned when you dismantle abyss heroic gear
item.skyabyss.abyss_diver_helmet.story: "Light on your brow. Never let your eyes get used to the dark."
item.skyabyss.abyss_diver_chestplate.sto: "It isn't the armor that's heavy. It's the way back up."
item.skyabyss.abyss_diver_leggings.story: "Don't kneel. Kneel, and you won't climb again."
item.skyabyss.abyss_diver_boots.story: "Quiet your steps. Something behind the wall is listening."
item.skyabyss.abyss_lamp_sword.story: "Whoever holds the lamp walks in front."
item.skyabyss.abyss_pulse_listener.story: "The heartbeat you hear is never just one."
item.skyabyss.abyss_lantern_charm.story: "Every lamp that goes out brings the dark one step closer."
item.skyabyss.abyss_pulse_dagger.story: "Strike on the beat. That's how a heart strikes."
item.skyabyss.abyss_surveyor_plumb.story: "A plumb never lies. It only tells you how deep."
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_no_clear.aby: Defeat the heart's warden to choose
